name: com.dnsmint/dnsmint
title: DNSMint
description: Mint and manage hostnames on domains DNSMint operates, so an agent can name a machine mid-task without a zone of its own.

environmentVariables.name: DNSMINT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A DNSMint API key. Create one at https://dnsmint.com/app/settings.

environmentVariables.name: DNSMINT_ALLOW_RELEASE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose release_hostname. Releasing is permanent and the name is never issued again, so it is off by default.
